description: This file is a test script for managing and executing Vitest test specifications, including handling lock acquisition, test argument parsing, temporary include file management, and running tests via a PNPM runner.

methods.name: releaseLockOnce
methods.description: Ensures the lock acquired by acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync is released only once.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Deletes temporary include files associated with a test spec to perform cleanup.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Runs a Vitest specification by spawning a child process with specified arguments and handles cleanup after execution.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Constructs the initial test run specification based on CLI arguments and environment.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous entry point that coordinates test execution, locking, and process management.
